methods.name: public void add(LeafAtom atom)

* Adds a child leaf to this container.
     *
     * @param atom The child to add.

methods.name: public void add(ContainerAtom atom)
methods.comment:
* Adds a child container to this container.
     *
     * @param atom The child to add.

methods.name: public LeafAtom getLeafAtomOfType(int type)
methods.comment:
* Returns the child leaf of the given type. * *

If no child exists with the given type then null is returned. If multiple children exist * with the given type then the first one to have been added is returned. * * @param type The leaf type. * @return The child leaf of the given type, or null if no such child exists.

methods.name: public ContainerAtom getContainerAtomOfType(int type)
methods.comment:
* Returns the child container of the given type. * *

If no child exists with the given type then null is returned. If multiple children exist * with the given type then the first one to have been added is returned. * * @param type The container type. * @return The child container of the given type, or null if no such child exists.

methods.name: public int getChildAtomOfTypeCount(int type)
methods.comment:
* Returns the total number of leaf/container children of this atom with the given type.
     *
     * @param type The type of child atoms to count.
     * @return The total number of leaf/container children of this atom with the given type.
